thread:
kevin: quick report: reproduced a bundler -> edge runtime issue that shows up as token refresh flakiness when apps use default imports from the JS SDK. minimal repro attached.

noura: what bundler + runtime combo?

kevin: observed on Vite (build SSR -> edge), Rollup (prod build), and one older webpack config. Dev servers were fine. Symptoms: intermittent 401s from the SDK, then repeated retry attempts that never recover. TS also flags default export types in some apps.

liam: can you paste the minimal steps?

kevin: sure: 
1) create a fresh vite react-ts app
2) npm i @redwood/inference-js (local dev build)
3) in src/main.tsx: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`
4) build for ssr and run on node or deploy to CF worker -> call an API that triggers SDK auth
Expected: token fetch and request succeed.
Observed: runtime log: `AuthError: token missing` then `RetryAttempt: token fetch returned undefined` and the retry loop. Types: editor warns about `namespace has no default export` or `type has no call signatures`.

sdk-bot: note: CI flaky job sample-app-edge (#258) showing similar failure.

noura: sounds like classic ESM/CJS interop: default import becomes `{ default: ... }` wrapper depending on bundler output. Any workarounds for app teams?

kevin: validated workarounds: 
- Use named import: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` (best)
- Vite: add `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` in vite.config.ts or include package in optimizeDeps so build preserves ESM shape
- Rollup: ensure commonjs plugin processes node_modules, or mark the package as external so ESM entrypoint is preserved
- Webpack: enable .mjs handling or set `type: 'javascript/esm'` for the package in module rules
- TS: `esModuleInterop` + `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` as a last resort to silence types

liam: can we fix package side?

kevin: proposals: 
A) add explicit conditional exports in package.json: "exports": {"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}
B) ship a tiny ESM-only entry (index.mjs) that re-exports named exports (no default). This avoids interop wrappers and keeps runtime shape predictable.
C) update types to include a synthetic default for compatibility, but prefer explicit ESM entry.

noura: please create a tiny repro gist for both vite and rollup so eng-ci can add matrix tests. Also add a one-liner to onboarding docs: "If you see 401s after build: switch to named import or set ssr.noExternal for vite."

kevin: will push two gists (vite-edge-repro, rollup-edge-repro) with exact build commands and a small server to show logs. I'll also open a short PR prototype that adds index.mjs and an exports map in a branch for testing.

liam: I'll add a CI job that runs the repro builds and runs the auth-integration smoke to catch regressions.

sdk-bot: recorded issue #789: "sdk: bundler interop causes auth retry flake on edge" (linked to gist when available).

kevin: thanks — tagging @noura for docs review once I push the readme.
